One example, I recently purchased an iPad from Temu, which couldn’t even be turned on. No lightening cable etc; as advertised. iPad couldn’t be examined for functionality and was returned within two hours of receipt. Yet Temu is delaying refund.

data.review_body:
I ordered a pair of 1kg weights and when they arrived they were 8kg each,  I contacted Temu who arranged for them to be collected.  The day came and went and the courier did not arrive.  I then emailed Temu but it went to the wrong address.  I finally managed to get through to a customer service agent.  She kept on putting me on hold whilst she reviewed the order and finally came back saying there was no order of that number on her system.  She checked again and then put me on hold so she could speak to her supervisor,  I was then cut off.  Since then I have been unable to sort this out and they still have not been collected.  I have not recieved the promised refund and now Temu have emailed to say they will close the query.
I am sick, sorry and tired of trying to sort this out with a company who avoid customer contact and complaints.  They are happy to take the money and try and upsell but should an issue arise they run for the trees.  
I think some of the items they sell are brilliant and very good quality but they need a serious rethink on customer services  - first priority is to involve the customer and be available.
